Anya (CS): Brainstorm: 'Onboard dark' quick-rescue playbook. Trigger = accounts that had first_successful_login but zero meaningful engagement for 72 hours. Objectives: get enablement feedback, offer a short help session, and reduce early churn risk.

Jamal: Where will we source this signal? CRM field + event stream? Also propose pilot cohort size and inclusion criteria.

Anya (CS): Plan: use `first_successful_login_ts` from telemetry; fallback to `crm.custom_fields.onboard_started_at`. Exclude `do_not_contact` or `suppress_nudges`. Pilot: ARR >= $5k OR seats >= 8; 10% randomized sample of eligible.

Leo: Engineering constraints: please ensure we write `nudge_sent_at` and `nudge_id` to the account record on send to prevent double-sends. Use dedup window for engagement events (30m) to avoid false negatives. Contact-owner mapping required for AE escalation option.

Leo: Draft selector SQL for ops team:
```sql
SELECT a.id AS account_id
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN account_contacts c ON c.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.first_successful_login_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(a.last_meaningful_engagement_ts, '1970-01-01') < NOW() - INTERVAL '72 hours'
  AND (a.arr >= 5000 OR a.seats >= 8)
  AND a.status = 'active'
  AND COALESCE(a.suppress_nudges, false) = false
  AND COALESCE(c.owner_email, '') <> ''
LIMIT 400;
```

Anya (CS): Great. Ops/Eng: can we add `last_meaningful_engagement_ts`, `nudge_sent_at`, `nudge_id`, and `suppress_nudges` into the playbook topic? We'll need them for idempotency and monitoring.

Jamal: Yep. I'll spin up a tiny producer job to emit those fields into the playbook kafka topic. Will include `nudge_id` (uuid) and `nudge_channel` (email/in-app). ETA: tomorrow 10am.

Priya (Enablement): I'll write two message variants: (A) checklist + 15-min schedule link, (B) AE reachout template for higher ARR. Will share copy and short script for AEs by EOD.

Playbook Bot: Staging dry run created: run_id=run_onboard_dark_2024_11_28_01. Sample CSV and logs available: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/runs/run_onboard_dark_2024_11_28_01

Leo: Backoff policy suggestion: send automated nudge at 72h, second automated at day 7, escalate to AE at day 10 if still unresponsive. Respect `do_not_contact` and `suppress_nudges`. Add a single feature-flag `playbook.onboard_dark` for quick toggles.

Anya (CS): Action items summary: 
- @Jamal: produce topic fields + idempotency token + tagging (ETA tomorrow 10am)
- @Leo: implement backoff/escalation + feature flag in playbook runtime
- @Priya: deliver A/B copy, scheduling link, AE script (EOD)
- @Anya: prepare rollout checklist, sampling plan, monitoring dashboard inputs

Jamal: I'll also add an alert on run failure rate > 1% and a metric for nudge->engagement conversion.

Priya (Enablement): I'll prep a quick support doc for AEs and include suggested subject lines and one-sentence openings.

Anya (CS): No objections to starting a 10% pilot in staging today and running a shadow in prod next week once logs look good? :thumbsup: 

Leo: Fine. One more ask: include a boolean `escalated_to_ae` on the account record when escalations fire so we can measure AE workload.

Anya (CS): Will include that in the checklist. Thanks all — I'll post the checklist + task assignments in #cs-ops shortly.
